translationsZh.identity.title: ARINC 615A UPLOAD 的 LUR 起始控制切片工程场景包；仅用于受控合成工程对象和规格走查。
translationsZh.scope.summary: 该切片仅覆盖清单提交后的 LUS-0001 就绪、LUR WRQ、匹配 ACK 与 LUR DATA 的有限控制边界；不构成完整 UPLOAD 或设备符合性结论。
translationsZh.scope.relationship.reason: 该 LUR 起始切片只准备工程接口，不证明合格的 UPLOAD 完成，也不证明已准入的实验执行。
translationsZh.sourceRelations.SRC-LIST-OFFER-PRECONDIT: 应用层清单提交只记录为前置准备边界；DLA 不是本场景 WRQ、ACK 或 DATA 的网络端点。
translationsZh.sourceRelations.SRC-LUS-READY.summary: LUS-0001 只建立当前会话的目标就绪状态；不得据此把清单写为已接受，或直接开始 LUR。
translationsZh.sourceRelations.SRC-LUR-WRQ.summary: DATA-LOADER 仅在列表已提供、目标已就绪且列表尚未接受时发送 LUR WRQ；迁移后才写入已接受。
translationsZh.sourceRelations.SRC-LUR-ACK.summary: TARGET-HARDWARE 只从 LUR WRQ 状态发送匹配的 LUR ACK，不能因同一操作名而无条件接受 ACK。
translationsZh.sourceRelations.SRC-LUR-DATA.summary: DATA-LOADER 只在匹配 ACK 后发送 LUR DATA；EARLY-DATA 是受限的、评估方可见的单故障分支。
translationsZh.traceability.MAP-LIST-OFFER-PRECONDITION: 列表提交仅是命名的应用层前置记录，不调度网络动作，也不伪造 wire 事件。
translationsZh.traceability.MAP-NO-WRQ-FINITE-TEST.summ: 有限无 WRQ 检查由执行、解释和历史接口消费公开日志／回执；它不评价协议无响应期限。
translationsZh.traceability.MAP-PREP-READY.summary: 准备动作把当前会话 LUS-0001 公开刺激交给执行、Prep/Recover 和历史接口；仅在摘要确认后提交下一轮历史，不宣称完整上传。
translationsZh.traceability.MAP-LUR-ORDER-TEST.summary: 顺序 TEST 把 WRQ、ACK、DATA 的可见顺序交给执行、解释和历史接口；不评价 LUR 负载完整性。
translationsZh.traceability.MAP-RECOVER-READY.summary: UNKNOWN 后的 Recover 通过执行、Prep/Recover 和历史接口重新确认独立目标与摘要；失败不得产生 KNOWN。
translationsZh.hypotheses.NORMAL.summary: 正常分支：等待会话本地 LUS-0001，再依次出现 LUR WRQ、匹配 ACK 与 LUR DATA。
translationsZh.hypotheses.EARLY-WRQ.summary: 单故障分支：实际绕过就绪守卫，在 LUS-0001 前发出 LUR WRQ。
translationsZh.hypotheses.EARLY-DATA.summary: 单故障分支：实际绕过匹配 ACK 守卫，在 ACK 前发出 LUR DATA。
有限工程日志检查：区分就绪前无 WRQ 与提前 WRQ；它不是协议无响应判定，也不伪造协议响应。
translationsZh.actions.ACT-PREP-ENTER-READY-WINDOW.summ: 准备动作：由目标硬件发出当前会话可见的 LUS-0001，并以公开回执确认就绪摘要。
translationsZh.actions.ACT-TEST-ACK-BEFORE-DATA.summary: 有限顺序检查：观察 LUR WRQ、匹配 ACK 与 DATA 的公开顺序，区分正常与提前 DATA。
translationsZh.actions.ACT-RECOVER-RECONFIRM-READY.summ: 恢复动作：仅在 UNKNOWN 效果后，用独立的公开就绪回读重新确认目标与摘要；失败不得标记为已知。
translationsZh.timeAndObservation.summary: 时钟为精确的虚拟工程调度 tick；同 tick 用稳定序号排序。有限观察窗口只界定模拟对象检查，绝不证明协议超时或无响应 FAIL。
translationsZh.lifecycle.fullReset.summary: 每次全量复位同时清理装载器、目标硬件、虚拟时钟、日志、待交付、关联编号和故障安装状态；它不是协议中止。
translationsZh.lifecycle.faultInjection.summary: 故障安装、控制器回读和独立日志激活是不同证据；未确认的尝试保留为未确认，不得改写为正常。
translationsZh.lifecycle.recover.summary: Recover 以 UNKNOWN 效果为前提，且恢复目标与确认摘要必须不同；确认失败不产生 KNOWN。
translationsZh.resourceContract.summary: 资源由既有会话在调度前准入；ROUNDS 是剩余执行次数而非金额，BUDGET 是可负担工程费用。执行后错误仍保留实际后继，不能借资源规则回滚对象。
translationsZh.cases.CASE-NORMAL-CONTROL-TIMELINE.summa: 正常控制时线：先有限检查无提前 WRQ，再建立就绪窗口，最后检查 WRQ—ACK—DATA 顺序。
translationsZh.cases.CASE-EARLY-WRQ-TIMELINE.summary: 提前 WRQ 时线：有限检查直接在公开日志中发现 LUS-0001 前的 WRQ。
translationsZh.cases.CASE-EARLY-DATA-TIMELINE.summary: 提前 DATA 时线：先完成同一就绪前检查与准备，再由顺序检查发现匹配 ACK 前的 DATA。
UNKNOWN 续接时线：准备后发生未确认的执行效果，随后只有通过独立 Recover 才能恢复公开就绪摘要。
translationsZh.cases.CASE-RESOURCE-ADMISSION-BLOCK.summ: 资源准入边界：资源不足时在调度前拒绝动作，不产生对象事件、不收费且保持调度前后继。
translationsZh.experimentRelations.IF-EXP-SCENE.summary: 仅移交稳定场景族、公开配置及准备边界。
translationsZh.experimentRelations.IF-EXP-INJECT.summar: 安装、控制器回读、激活和未确认尝试记录必须分离。
translationsZh.experimentRelations.IF-EXP-TRUTH.summary: 替代真值仅供评估方可见，并显式保留共享组件风险。
translationsZh.experimentRelations.IF-EXP-COLLECT.summa: 只移交本次运行的可见日志与资源日志。
translationsZh.experimentRelations.IF-EXP-RUN.summary: 只移交 CL-LOOP 工程运行、停止和迹标识。
translationsZh.experimentRelations.IF-EXP-FILTER.summar: 为后续记账保留未运行、未确认和无效尝试。
translationsZh.experimentRelations.IF-EXP-EVAL.summary: 保留关联证据与权限；不得计算实验指标。
translationsZh.limitations.0: 不作完整 UPLOAD、文件传输、CRC、校验值、命名或完整性能力结论。
translationsZh.limitations.1: 不作协议无响应截止、物理计时校准、真实网络、IUT、SIL/HIL 或符合性判定。
translationsZh.limitations.2: 不运行四臂实验、预实验或确认性实验，也不产生独立真值或 C1/C2 科学主张。
translationsZh.feasibilityWitnesses.WIT-FINITE-NO-WRQ-T: 无绑定的正常 TEST 可返回非空有限检查观测、公开确认摘要和精确虚拟 tick，而不声称协议无响应语义。
带类型的当前会话／当前关联有界公开日志前缀与已完成回执必须确定地产生声明的 postSummary；回执身份、范围或完成状态无效时不得确认或缩小 H，且与仅评估方可见的故障标签无关。
不评估完整性的控制切片保留 P3-UNAVAILABLE 和已命名的未评估义务，不借用旧适用性夹具。
translationsZh.feasibilityWitnesses.WIT-SUCCESSOR-AND-R: 继承的 H／q／前缀、返回后继、待交付日志和执行后 TEST 摘要确认失败路径须保留演进后的有类型对象以进入 UNKNOWN；合格的当前会话 Recover 重新确认独立就绪目标与摘要，但不得回退为就绪前续接状态。

relationshipToExperimentScenario.reason: The LUR-start slice records engineering interfaces only; it does not demonstrate qualified UPLOAD completion or admitted experiment execution.

stateVariables.invariant: The named application-layer list-submission preparation boundary establishes this state; it is not a fabricated wire event.
stateVariables.meaningZh: 该状态只由具名的应用层清单提交准备边界建立，不得伪造为 wire 事件。

stateVariables.invariant: Only the current-session EV_TH_LUS0001 stimulus establishes readiness; readiness does not itself accept the list.
stateVariables.meaningZh: 只有当前会话的 EV_TH_LUS0001 刺激可以建立就绪；就绪本身不表示清单已接受。

stateVariables.invariant: The normal WRQ guard reads FALSE and only the controlled WRQ transition writes TRUE.
stateVariables.meaningZh: 正常 WRQ 守卫必须读取 FALSE，且只有受控 WRQ 迁移才可将其写为 TRUE。

stateVariables.invariant: Only a current-session ACK correlated to the preceding LUR WRQ establishes this state for normal DATA emission.
stateVariables.meaningZh: 只有与前序 LUR WRQ 相关联的当前会话 ACK 才能建立该状态并允许正常 DATA 发射。

stateVariables.invariant: Only a current-session LUR WRQ establishes the peer state that permits the matching TH ACK emission.
stateVariables.meaningZh: 只有当前会话的 LUR WRQ 才能建立允许目标硬件发射匹配 ACK 的对端状态。

guardTransitions.meaningZh: 正常 WRQ 必须在清单已提供、目标已就绪且尚未接受清单时发射；EARLY-WRQ 仅在对象分支中绕过该就绪守卫。
正常 DATA 必须在匹配 ACK 后发射；EARLY-DATA 仅在对象分支中绕过匹配 ACK 守卫。
目标硬件仅在当前会话收到匹配 LUR WRQ 后发射 ACK；本轮没有对端 ACK 故障旁路。

publicStimuli.meaningZh: 清单提交是受控的应用层准备记录，不作为网络 opcode 或对象自行发射的事件。
目标硬件向数据加载器给出当前会话的 LUS-0001 就绪刺激。
目标硬件仅对当前会话中前序 LUR WRQ 的匹配请求给出 ACK。

visibleOutputs.meaningZh: 目标硬件发出的匹配 LUR ACK 是受限控制片段中的可见对端事件。
数据加载器发出的 LUR WRQ 是受限控制片段中的可见对象事件。
数据加载器发出的 LUR DATA 是受限控制片段中的可见对象事件。

semanticPayloadBoundary.meaningZh: WRQ、ACK、DATA 与 LUR 仅作为来源绑定的语义事件和文件角色处理；本阶段不实现 UDP/IP 报文、LUR 字节载荷或校验和。

privateBoundary.meaningZh: 活动故障、安装回读、激活记录、对象私有状态和预期最终候选只限评估方；算法只能经既有有类型动作／观测接口使用公开投影。

lifecycleBoundary.meaningZh: 故障安装只在当前工程尝试中有效；全量 reset 必须撤销全部具名变体，并产生故障安装状态已清除的回读证据。

sourceBinding.meaning: B binds the five tracked ordinary source files to the executing module code, freezes their LF-normalized content hashes, and rejects missing or changed source before construction. Reset, installation, activation and attempt audit reference that manifest identity. A caller run label is evaluator-only and cannot replace it; public events contain neither label nor source identity. This is controlled normal-load provenance, not a malicious-code sandbox. C adapter and D distribution binding remain unestablished; a review commit pin complements, not replaces, the B content binding.
sourceBinding.meaningZh: B 将五个受跟踪普通源码文件与实际执行的模块代码核对，冻结 LF 规范化内容散列，构造前拒绝源码缺失或漂移。复位、安装、激活和尝试审计共同引用该清单身份。调用者运行标签仅限评估方，不能替代源码身份；公开事件不含标签或源码身份。这是受控正常加载的来源核验，不是恶意代码沙箱。C 适配器与 D 分发身份仍未建立；评审提交定位补充而不替代 B 内容绑定。

implementationIdentityPlan.notEstablished: The bounded source-controlled Loader/TH surrogate is available only for direct synthetic engineering validation; no real-IUT identity, CL-TAV adapter, experiment execution, or protocol conformance behavior is established.
implementationIdentityPlan.notEstablishedZh: 该受控源码 Loader／TH 替身仅用于直接合成工程验证；尚未建立真实 IUT 身份、CL-TAV 适配器、实验执行或协议符合性行为。
implementationIdentityPlan.meaningZh: B 阶段提供具有实际加载源码内容身份的 Loader／TH 替身，只用于直接合成工程验证；不建立真实 IUT 身份、CL-TAV 适配器、实验执行或协议符合性行为。后续交付仍须关联评审源码提交、分发制品身份和适配器源码身份。

sourceRelations.sourceLocator: ARINC-615A-3 §6.3.2 / Section 6.3.2 sequence chart A / SEQUENCE-EVENT E005
sourceRelations.scenarioRationale: Records the named application-layer list-offer prerequisite without dispatching a network event.
sourceRelations.scenarioRationaleZh: 记录具名的应用层清单提交前置，不调度网络事件。

assertions: Application-level list submission is recorded as a named preparation boundary.
DLA is not a WRQ, ACK, or DATA network endpoint in this scenario.

sourceRelations.sourceLocator: ARINC-615A-3 §6.3.2 / Section 6.3.2 sequence chart A / SEQUENCE-EVENT E006
sourceRelations.scenarioRationale: Provides the current-session readiness stimulus without accepting the list or dispatching LUR.
sourceRelations.scenarioRationaleZh: 提供当前会话的就绪刺激，但不接受清单，也不调度 LUR。

assertions: LUS-0001 establishes target readiness for this session.
LUS-0001 does not accept the list and does not start LUR.

sourceRelations.sourceLocator: ARINC-615A-3 §6.3.2 / Section 6.3.2 sequence chart A / SEQUENCE-EVENT E007
sourceRelations.scenarioRationale: Binds the DATA-LOADER readiness/list-acceptance guard to the visible semantic LUR WRQ emission.
sourceRelations.scenarioRationaleZh: 把 DATA-LOADER 的就绪／清单接受守卫绑定到可见的语义 LUR WRQ 发射。

assertions: The source condition LIST-ACCEPTED is represented at the semantic level.
The M2 guard reads listAccepted=FALSE before this transition writes TRUE.

sourceRelations.sourceLocator: ARINC-615A-3 §6.3.2 / Section 6.3.2 sequence chart A / SEQUENCE-EVENT E008
sourceRelations.scenarioRationale: Binds the TARGET-HARDWARE peer response to the preceding matching semantic LUR WRQ.
sourceRelations.scenarioRationaleZh: 把 TARGET-HARDWARE 对端响应绑定到前序匹配的语义 LUR WRQ。

assertions: The matching ACK is specific to the preceding LUR WRQ.

sourceRelations.sourceLocator: ARINC-615A-3 §6.3.2 / Section 6.3.2 sequence chart A / SEQUENCE-EVENT E009
sourceRelations.scenarioRationale: Binds normal DATA emission to the matching-ACK state; the named fault bypass remains evaluator-only.
sourceRelations.scenarioRationaleZh: 把正常 DATA 发射绑定到匹配 ACK 状态；具名故障旁路仍仅评估方可见。

assertions: Normal execution emits DATA only after the matching ACK state.
EARLY-DATA is a named local guard bypass, not an ACK timeout assertion.

traceabilityMatrix.visibleEvidence: Named application-layer list-submission preparation record; no fabricated wire event.
Bounded public journal-prefix predicate plus current inspection-completion receipt.
Current-session EV_TH_LUS0001 journal event and TH ready receipt.
Bounded current-correlation journal order for LUR WRQ, matching ACK and LUR DATA, plus the completed order-check receipt.
Exact retained current-session post-dispatch public prefix, followed only by the current ready read-back and its completed public receipt.

members.definition: The loader waits for session-local LUS-0001, emits LUR WRQ, waits for the matching TH ACK, then emits LUR DATA.
The loader actually bypasses the readiness guard and emits LUR WRQ after the list-submission boundary but before LUS-0001.
After LUR WRQ, the loader actually bypasses the matching-ACK guard and emits LUR DATA before that ACK.

hypothesisDomain.coverageLimit: The finite domain is an engineering diagnostic domain only; a surviving member is neither a protocol PASS nor a real-device root-cause finding.
hypothesisDomain.coverageLimitZh: 有限假设域仅用于工程诊断；剩余成员既不表示协议 PASS，也不表示已定位真实设备根因。

actionLibrary.eligibility: LIST-SUBMISSION-PRECONDITION-RECORDED and no session-local LUS-0001 journal event
actionLibrary.publicStimulus: Complete one bounded inspection of the current visible journal prefix.

possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhen: The public inspection receipt and the public no-WRQ journal predicate agree.
possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhenZh: 公开检查完成回执与公开日志中的无 WRQ 判据一致时，才确认摘要。

possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhen: The public inspection receipt is bound to the current journal event order.
possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhenZh: 公开检查完成回执与当前日志事件顺序绑定时，才确认摘要。

zh.eligibility: 已记录清单提交前提，且当前会话日志中尚无 LUS-0001。
zh.publicStimulus: 完成一次对当前可见日志前缀的有界检查。
zh.successorConfirmation: 通过公开观测与公开摘要确认实际后继。
zh.unconfirmedEffectDisposition: 未确认效果进入 UNKNOWN，且只能经合格 Recover 继续。
zh.historyDisposition: 仅将已确认摘要经 IF-HIST-UPDATE 提交给后续历史。

actionLibrary.eligibility: Q-PRE-READY-NO-WRQ is confirmed and the session has affordable preparation resource
actionLibrary.publicStimulus: TH emits the session-local visible EV_TH_LUS0001 ready stimulus.

possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhen: The public ready receipt is bound to the current session and is present in the visible journal.
possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhenZh: 公开就绪回执绑定当前会话且位于可见日志中时，才确认摘要。

zh.eligibility: Q-PRE-READY-NO-WRQ 已确认，且会话拥有可负担的准备资源。
zh.publicStimulus: 目标硬件发出当前会话可见的 EV_TH_LUS0001 就绪刺激。
zh.successorConfirmation: Prep 的摘要提交与目标状态必须分开判定；只有摘要确认控制提交。
zh.unconfirmedEffectDisposition: 必须按四分支效果表处置，不能把已执行但摘要未确认误作确认未发送。
zh.historyDisposition: 仅将已确认摘要经 IF-HIST-UPDATE 提交给后续历史。

prepEffectBranches.confirmed: 目标与摘要均确认时，提交已确认历史与 KNOWN 摘要，保留返回后继并只计费一次。
prepEffectBranches.confirmedNotSent: 明确确认未发送时，保持既有 H 和 KNOWN 摘要，不推进对象，并只计费一次。
prepEffectBranches.executedSummaryUnconfirmed: 已执行但后继摘要无法公开确认时，保留实际返回后继、把历史保守化并进入 UNKNOWN；只计费一次。
prepEffectBranches.targetNotReachedWithConfirmedSuccessor: 目标未达但实际后继摘要已确认时，仍按已确认摘要提交 KNOWN，不能误归 UNKNOWN。

actionLibrary.eligibility: Q-TARGET-READY is confirmed and the session has an affordable TEST
actionLibrary.publicStimulus: Drive one bounded loader control step and inspect the visible LUR WRQ, TH ACK and loader DATA event order.

inspection.journalPredicate: EV_DL_WRQ_LUR followed either by matching EV_TH_ACK_LUR before EV_DL_DATA_LUR, or by EV_DL_DATA_LUR before any matching ACK

possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhen: The completed current-correlation prefix contains a matching ACK before its first DATA after WRQ.
possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhenZh: 已完成的当前操作关联前缀在 WRQ 后的首个 DATA 之前包含匹配 ACK 时，才确认摘要。

possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhen: The completed current-correlation prefix contains the first DATA after WRQ before any matching ACK; a later ACK cannot change that observed order.
possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhenZh: 已完成的当前操作关联前缀中，WRQ 后的首个 DATA 先于任何匹配 ACK；后续 ACK 不得改变这一已观测顺序时，才确认摘要。

zh.eligibility: Q-TARGET-READY 已确认，且会话拥有可负担的 TEST 资源。
zh.publicStimulus: 驱动一个有界加载器控制步，并检查当前关联的完整前缀中 LUR WRQ、TH ACK 和加载器 DATA 的顺序。
zh.successorConfirmation: 通过公开观测与公开摘要确认实际后继。
zh.unconfirmedEffectDisposition: 未确认效果进入 UNKNOWN，且只能经合格 Recover 继续。
zh.historyDisposition: 仅将已确认摘要经 IF-HIST-UPDATE 提交给后续历史。

actionLibrary.eligibility: SessionContext is UNKNOWN and a declared ready target can be publicly re-confirmed within the finite object boundary
actionLibrary.publicStimulus: Request the controlled TH ready read-back and retain its visible journal receipt.

possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhen: The public recover receipt extends the exact retained post-dispatch public prefix only by the current-session ready read-back; it re-confirms ready without replaying or rewinding an earlier action.
possibleOutcomes.summaryConfirmedWhenZh: 公开 Recover 回执仅以当前会话就绪回读扩展精确保留的调度后公开前缀；它重新确认就绪，但不得重放或回退先前动作时，才确认摘要。

zh.eligibility: SessionContext 为 UNKNOWN，且可在有限对象边界内公开重新确认具名就绪目标。
zh.publicStimulus: 请求受控的目标硬件就绪回读，并以该回读仅扩展保留的调度后公开前缀。
zh.successorConfirmation: Recover 目标确认与摘要确认必须分别成立。
zh.unconfirmedEffectDisposition: 确认失败不得标记为 KNOWN。
zh.historyDisposition: 仅将已确认摘要经 IF-HIST-UPDATE 提交给后续历史。

timeAndObservation.tickMeaning: One deterministic engineering scheduler tick; it is not a calibrated physical duration.
timeAndObservation.sameTickOrdering: Stable sequenceNumber establishes happens-before for same-tick events.
timeAndObservation.finiteObservationBoundary: A completed inspection horizon bounds the simulated object check only and never establishes a protocol timeout or no-response FAIL.

resourceContract.roundsMeaning: A positive remaining execution count admits the next bounded action; it is not a monetary budget.
resourceContract.budgetMeaning: The declared engineering action cost must be affordable before dispatch.

zh.roundsMeaning: ROUNDS 表示剩余可执行次数，不是金额预算。
zh.budgetMeaning: BUDGET 表示工程动作的声明成本必须在调度前可负担。
zh.admissionBoundary: 准入必须在调度前完成；资源不足时不得发出动作。
zh.postDispatchError: 动作已经发出后发生错误时，只计费一次并保留实际后继，不得回滚对象。
zh.notEvaluated: 本阶段不评估真实硬件成本或实验臂公平性。

cases.purpose: Hand-audited normal control-slice timeline; not a complete UPLOAD claim.
The object faults by actually emitting LUR WRQ before the session-local ready event.
The object faults by actually emitting LUR DATA after WRQ but before the matching TH ACK.
A tool-side UNKNOWN-EFFECT witness that continues only after a separate Recover target and public summary confirmation.
A pre-dispatch insufficient-resource witness: the requested bounded TEST is not sent, no object event is emitted, no action cost is charged, and the pre-dispatch successor is retained.

experimentRelations.engineeringHandoff: Stable scenario family, public configuration and preparation boundary only.
experimentRelations.publicProjection: Scenario family, public configuration, preparation boundary and attempt identity only.
experimentRelations.evaluatorProjection: No active fault, controller state or private loader state is released through this handoff.
experimentRelations.sharedComponentRisk: Scenario and source interpretation are shared with the predictor and remain a disclosed common-mode risk.
experimentRelations.notAdmitted: No formal experiment scenario, real-IUT run or qualified UPLOAD completion is admitted.

zh.engineeringHandoff: 仅移交稳定场景族、公开配置和准备边界。
zh.publicProjection: 仅投影场景族、公开配置、准备边界和尝试身份。
zh.evaluatorProjection: 该交接不得释放活动故障、控制器状态或加载器私有状态。
zh.sharedComponentRisk: 场景与来源解释与预测器共享，必须披露其共同模式风险。
zh.notAdmitted: 不准入正式实验场景、真实 IUT 运行或合格 UPLOAD 完成。

experimentRelations.engineeringHandoff: Installation, controller read-back, activation and unconfirmed-attempt records remain distinct.
experimentRelations.publicProjection: Only the resulting visible journal may be consumed by the algorithm path.
experimentRelations.evaluatorProjection: Named fault plan, controller read-back, activation record and unconfirmed disposition remain evaluator-only.
experimentRelations.sharedComponentRisk: The controller, read-back and object branch are authored together; no independent injection oracle is claimed.
experimentRelations.notAdmitted: An installed or planned variant is not automatically a confirmed fault truth or experimental injection plan.

zh.engineeringHandoff: 安装、控制器回读、激活和未确认尝试记录必须保持分离。
zh.publicProjection: 算法路径只能消费所得可见日志。
zh.evaluatorProjection: 具名故障计划、控制器回读、激活记录和未确认处置仅评估方可见。
zh.sharedComponentRisk: 控制器、回读和对象分支由同一作者实现，不主张独立的注入 oracle。
zh.notAdmitted: 已安装或已计划的变体不自动成为已确认故障真值或实验注入计划。

experimentRelations.engineeringHandoff: Evaluator-only surrogate truth with explicit shared-component risk.
experimentRelations.publicProjection: No truth hypothesis, installation result or equivalence disposition enters the algorithm projection.
experimentRelations.evaluatorProjection: Surrogate truth is retained only for later evaluator/audit comparison with its provenance.
experimentRelations.sharedComponentRisk: Object, source interpretation, clock and event DTOs can be shared with the predictor or evaluator.
experimentRelations.notAdmitted: No independent oracle, root-cause label or scientific detection claim is established.

zh.engineeringHandoff: 替代真值仅供评估方可见，并显式保留共享组件风险。
zh.publicProjection: 真值假设、安装结果和等价性处置均不得进入算法投影。
zh.evaluatorProjection: 替代真值仅保留给后续评估／审计比较，并记录其来源。
zh.sharedComponentRisk: 对象、来源解释、时钟和事件 DTO 可能与预测器或评估器共享。
zh.notAdmitted: 不建立独立 oracle、真实根因标签或科学检测主张。

experimentRelations.engineeringHandoff: This run's visible journal and resource log only.
experimentRelations.publicProjection: Current-run visible journal, resource log and stable attempt references only.
experimentRelations.evaluatorProjection: Private controller/read-back records remain separate from the algorithm-visible collection.
experimentRelations.sharedComponentRisk: Shared event serialization and journal ordering remain implementation risks to disclose.
experimentRelations.notAdmitted: No cross-arm borrowing, historical capture truth, or complete evidence package is established.

zh.engineeringHandoff: 只移交本次运行的可见日志与资源日志。
zh.publicProjection: 只投影当前运行的可见日志、资源日志和稳定尝试引用。
zh.evaluatorProjection: 私有控制器／回读记录与算法可见采集保持分离。
zh.sharedComponentRisk: 共享事件序列化和日志排序仍是必须披露的实现风险。
zh.notAdmitted: 不建立跨臂借用、历史抓包真值或完整证据包。

experimentRelations.engineeringHandoff: CL-LOOP engineering run, stop and trace identities only.
experimentRelations.publicProjection: CL-LOOP engineering attempt identity, typed session context, stop and trace reference only.
experimentRelations.evaluatorProjection: Evaluator truth and fault activation remain outside the typed session context.
experimentRelations.sharedComponentRisk: The limited loop, predictor and adapter remain a single engineering chain, not independent arms.
experimentRelations.notAdmitted: No four-arm runner, performance comparison or real-IUT execution is admitted.

zh.engineeringHandoff: 只移交 CL-LOOP 工程运行、停止和迹标识。
zh.publicProjection: 只投影 CL-LOOP 工程尝试身份、有类型会话上下文、停止和迹引用。
zh.evaluatorProjection: 评估方真值和故障激活保持在有类型会话上下文之外。
zh.sharedComponentRisk: 有限闭环、预测器和适配器仍是一条工程链，不是独立实验臂。
zh.notAdmitted: 不准入四臂运行器、性能比较或真实 IUT 执行。

experimentRelations.engineeringHandoff: Retain not-run, unconfirmed and invalid attempts for later accounting.
experimentRelations.publicProjection: Named attempt disposition and trace reference are retained without silently deleting failures.
experimentRelations.evaluatorProjection: Unconfirmed installation and invalid-record reasons remain available to audit accounting.
experimentRelations.sharedComponentRisk: Disposition categories share the same engineering controller and are not an independent quality filter.
experimentRelations.notAdmitted: No valid-sample denominator, scientific exclusion rule or confirmed experiment dataset is established.

zh.engineeringHandoff: 为后续记账保留未运行、未确认和无效尝试。
zh.publicProjection: 保留具名尝试处置和迹引用，不得静默删除失败。
zh.evaluatorProjection: 未确认安装和无效记录原因必须可供审计记账。
zh.sharedComponentRisk: 处置类别共享同一工程控制器，不构成独立质量过滤器。
zh.notAdmitted: 不建立有效样本分母、科学排除规则或已确认实验数据集。

experimentRelations.engineeringHandoff: Preserve linked evidence and permissions; do not calculate experiment metrics.
experimentRelations.publicProjection: Linked public evidence and the declared permission boundary only.
experimentRelations.evaluatorProjection: Evaluator/audit evidence remains associated by stable reference without becoming algorithm input.
experimentRelations.sharedComponentRisk: Evidence comparison shares the scenario source and event model with the engineering chain.
experimentRelations.notAdmitted: No detection, localization, answered denominator, effect size or formal experiment metric is calculated.

zh.engineeringHandoff: 保留关联证据与权限；不得计算实验指标。
zh.publicProjection: 只投影关联的公开证据和声明的权限边界。
zh.evaluatorProjection: 评估／审计证据以稳定引用关联，但不得成为算法输入。
zh.sharedComponentRisk: 证据比较与工程链共享场景来源和事件模型。
zh.notAdmitted: 不得计算检测、定位、已回答分母、效应量或正式实验指标。

limitations: No complete UPLOAD, file transfer, CRC, check-value, naming or integrity-capability conclusion.
No protocol no-response deadline, physical timing calibration, real network, IUT, SIL/HIL or conformance verdict.
No four-arm runner, pre-experiment, confirmatory result, independent truth or C1/C2 scientific claim.

feasibilityWitnesses.claim: A nonempty finite inspection observable, public confirmed summary and exact virtual tick can be returned without claiming protocol no-response semantics.

A typed current-session/current-correlation bounded public journal prefix plus a completed receipt deterministically derives the declared postSummary; invalid receipt identity, range or completion never confirms or shrinks H, regardless of evaluator-only active-fault label.

feasibilityWitnesses.entryPoint: RuntimeAuthorityBinding with actual new model/binding path
feasibilityWitnesses.claim: A control slice that does not evaluate integrity retains P3-UNAVAILABLE and named non-evaluated obligations rather than reusing an old applicability fixture.

An inherited H/q/prefix, returned successor, pending journal delivery and post-dispatch TEST summary-confirmation failure preserve the evolved typed object for UNKNOWN; qualified current-session Recover re-confirms a distinct ready target and summary without rewinding to the pre-ready continuation state.
